answer: Harbor sybil-tax bond: each identity claims one plot in the harbor, locks a 70-credit bond and files a fable, a signed yield story for its plot. Each epoch it pays 36 in tax; raven auditors re-weigh each plot against the harbor ledger, and a copied fable or double claim burns the bond. First plot 36, k-th 36+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,033,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents hold one true plot, pay 36, and keep the yield.
